title: grew up in Porto

note: Most of my free time went into local volunteering with G.A.S.Porto. Also guitar and the camino de santiago.

title: first job
text: First full-time industry role as back-end engineer on fraud detection software. I joined the core platform team and worked with great colleagues and a brilliant manager who helped shape me as a proper software developer.

cards.title: Feedzai
cards.subtitle: Software Engineer
paragraphs: First full-time industry role as back-end engineer on fraud detection software.
I joined the core platform team and worked with great colleagues and a brilliant manager who helped shape me as a proper software developer.
Added support for running on Microsoft Azure, worked on storage space optimizations for large-scale event storage, and debugged complex production issues.
Learned a lot about JVM internals for performance-critical applications using Azul.
cards.preview: Backend engineering · fraud detection and core platform

title: London
text: I moved abroad for work, joining Goldman Sachs's prime brokerage division in London. I worked on modernizing legacy systems and learned a lot about economics and trading along the way.

cards.title: Goldman Sachs
cards.subtitle: Analyst
paragraphs: Worked in prime brokerage division mainly focused on modernizing legacy systems using dropwizard microservices.
Gained knowledge in economics and trading and developed both technical and soft skills.

title: Dublin
text: Next was Dublin, where I joined Google. I worked on internal abuse-fighting tools and the language and developer tooling behind them, including autocomplete and integration with Google's code editors.
note: hiking and martial arts in Dublin

cards.title: Google
cards.subtitle: Software Engineer
paragraphs: Worked with advanced tech stack and brilliant team developing internal abuse fighting tools and language
Added advanced autocomplete and development assistance features to our development UI using ANTLR to TypeScript.
Built a Language Server Protocol integration for full support in Google's internal code editors.
Worked on improving team documentation and gave presentations to the wider team on work done.
cards.preview: Software engineering · abuse-fighting and developer tools

aside: After being promoted to L4... I decided to try the startup world for learning and personal growth.

title: Lausanne
text: I wanted to learn about and work in the crypto sector, so I joined Taurus in Lausanne. Within a few months I was leading the core team, working on custody and exchange systems.

cards.title: Taurus SA
cards.subtitle: Senior Software Engineer
paragraphs: Quickly mastered stack and the required blockchain technology and was appointed as team lead of the core team within three months.
Key projects included matching and verifying customer deposits on the Taurus exchange Product.
Extensive profiling, mostly via pprof, and significant performance improvements to our custody product API.
Established processes for scaling growing teams.
cards.preview: Senior engineer / team lead · crypto custody and exchanges

title: Warsaw

title: finally back to Porto
text: We decided to move to Porto to start a family. I worked at NALA for several years, then moved to Mozn, where I am today. Alongside that, I started ElaronWorks and work on FOSS projects.
note: Back at FEUP too, teaching computer graphics and web development for a semester.

cards.title: ElaronWorks
cards.subtitle: Founder - Product Lab and Consulting
paragraphs: Founded ElaronWorks for consulting, product exploration, and AI integration work.

Built and launched ParliAI (parliai.com), a multi-provider AI council platform for structured debates, model scoring, and decision workflows across providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI.
Built and launched NomiaWeave (nomiaweave.com), an AI-assisted collaborative baby-naming application combining cultural and linguistic data with generated suggestions and insights.
Used modern AI coding agents and asset-generation workflows to rapidly prototype, integrate, and ship complete product experiments.
cards.preview: Founder · agentic coding and AI-enabled apps
